data.text: Event sourcing stores state as a sequence of events. Instead of storing the current state, you store the events that led to it. The current state is derived by replaying events.

terms.definition: Storing state as a sequence of events.
A database optimized for storing events.
A cluster of domain objects treated as a single unit.

items: Time travel: rebuild state at any point
Events are the source of truth

data.text: An event store is optimized for appending and reading events. It typically supports streams (one per aggregate) and snapshots to speed up replay.

data.caption: Event Sourcing Flow
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Cmd[Command] --> Agg[Aggregate]
    Agg -->|Events| ES[(Event Store)]
    ES -->|Replay| State[Current State]
    ES -->|Projections| RM[(Read Model)]

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Event sourcing stores events, not state
State is derived by replaying events
data.takeaway: Event sourcing provides a complete audit trail and time travel.
